agentId.description: The agent's id, as list_agents answered it.

title.description: The agent's title as its tab shows it; empty clears it, so the tab shows the model's name.

model.description: The model it runs on from its next step, by its catalog id as list_models answers it; given with the effort or not at all.

effort.description: The reasoning effort, as the model lists it; given with the model or not at all.

contextWindow.description: The context window it runs on, standard or long; only with a model, and the model's whole window where left out.

pinned.description: Whether the member keeps it pinned in their sidebar, the pin theirs alone; an agent on a task or on none alike.

disabledServers.description: The MCP servers switched off for the agent, by connection name, the whole list, which replaces the one standing; empty switches every server back on. Its next turn reads it.

archived.description: true to archive it, as the member's Archive agent would: it leaves the sidebar, its task's tabs, and every list but the archived ones, takes no message, and is not woken, its transcript, branch, and pull request kept; a turn still running is stopped first. false to bring an archived one back.

reason.description: Why it is archived, in a short sentence its archived banner shows beside the member's name, such as its pull request having merged; only with archived true.

branch.description: The branch to clone its checkout at, which must already be on GitHub; leave it out for its default branch.

addRepository.description: A repository the agent works in beside its own from now on, added after the others and checked out in a folder of its own, which its token then reaches and it is told of; named alone, with no other change. Only for an agent the member started, in the cloud, in a repository of its own, its repositories all reached through one GitHub App installation, and the member with the Several repositories experiment on. Nothing removes one.
